text: Praise the Lord, my soul;I will praise the Lord all my life,sing praise to my God while I live. [AA]
I Put no trust in princes,in children of Adam powerless to save. [AB]
Who breathing his last, returns to the earth;that day all his planning comes to nothing. [AC]
II Blessed the one whose help is the God of Jacob,whose hope is in the Lord, his God,
The maker of heaven and earth,the seas and all that is in them, [AD]Who keeps faith forever,
secures justice for the oppressed, [AE]who gives bread to the hungry.The Lord sets prisoners free; [AF]
the Lord gives sight to the blind.The Lord raises up those who are bowed down; [AG]the Lord loves the righteous.
The Lord protects the resident alien,comes to the aid of the orphan and the widow, [AH]but thwarts the way of the wicked.
The Lord shall reign forever,your God, Zion, through all generations! [AI]Hallelujah!
